VIXCLS.license_note: FRED label 'Copyrighted: Citation required' (source CBOE, reprinted with permission); FRED terms: internal use with attribution to FRED and original source. Cross-check file vix/VIX_History_cboe.csv (sha256 4bca3f49062d5196f00cf6e62d04f77304608884ca4d791d2e7210e274d52796, CBOE direct, single-copy internal use per cboe.com/terms) agrees on all 9,278 common dates, max |diff| = 0.
VIXCLS.available_at_rule: FRED mirror lag measured 1-3 business days (frozen conservative: value of day d usable from d+3 business days; a Friday 17:00 ET decision then consumes the prior Monday at worst). If the engine wires the CBOE-direct file instead (see license_note), the rule upgrades to: value of day d usable from d 16:15 ET (Friday 17:00 ET decision consumes Thursday close, margin 24h45m). '.' rows are holidays/missing - carry as NaN, do not forward-fill silently.

DCOILBRENTEU.license_note: FRED label 'Public Domain: Citation requested'; source U.S. EIA (US-government work). Citation: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Crude Oil Prices: Brent - Europe [DCOILBRENTEU], retrieved from FRED. Values identical to EIA's own history page on all 9,092 common dates (max |diff| = 0).
DCOILBRENTEU.available_at_rule: EIA releases the daily spot table weekly on Wednesday, covering through the prior Tuesday (stated Release Date 9/23/2026, Next Release 9/30/2026; corroborated by 3 Wayback vintages). FROZEN RULE: at a Friday 17:00 ET decision, consume only observations with date <= (decision Friday - 10 calendar days) [normal case is T-3; worst holiday-clustered case measured 9 days and arithmetically capped at 10-11]. '.' rows = no data reported (holidays); carry as NaN.

DCOILWTICO.license_note: FRED label 'Public Domain: Citation requested'; source U.S. EIA (US-government work). Citation: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Crude Oil Prices: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) - Cushing, Oklahoma [DCOILWTICO], retrieved from FRED. Values identical to EIA's own history page on all 9,507 common dates (max |diff| = 0).
DCOILWTICO.available_at_rule: Same as DCOILBRENTEU: weekly Wednesday EIA release through prior Tuesday; FROZEN RULE: consume only observations with date <= (decision Friday - 10 calendar days). NOTE: negative values are genuine data (2020-04-20 = -36.98 USD/bbl, present in both channels) - loaders must accept negatives; winsorize only at the feature layer.

EFFR.license_note: NY Fed reference rates, keyless public API (markets.newyorkfed.org/api/rates/unsecured/EFFR/search.json). 'Use of the Reference Rates are subject to important disclaimers, limitations and indemnification obligations.' Internal research use; rows are newest-first; revisionIndicator served per row (1 flagged of 2,696: 2017-05-31).
EFFR.available_at_rule: Value of effectiveDate d is published the next NY Fed business day at approximately 9:00 a.m. ET; same-day revisions possible until ~14:30 ET (1bp threshold). FROZEN RULE: value of d usable from d+1 15:00 ET; a Friday 17:00 ET decision consumes Thursday's EFFR (2.5h margin past the revision window). Skip rows where revisionIndicator != '' only if the engine wants first-print values; they are auditable, not errors.
